messages.subject: Re: Working PHP Y Rapache
parts:
If you want to link R with PHP, you can use PHP cURL module to send POST requests to R. Head over to PHP manual pages to learn more about cURL module: http://www.php.net/manual/en/book.curl.php
And this link should also be useful: http://davidwalsh.name/execute-http-post-php-curl
Once sent, you can easily grab them from RApache POST superglobal.
